name: Default No-Blades Hitter
dsl: ?(deck.remaining >= 2) any<mod_damage> @ spell(any<damage & aoe>) & any<mod_damage> @ spell(any<damage>) & potent @ spell(any<trap>) & potent @ spell(any<trap>) | ?(self.health < 30%) any<heal> @ self | ?(self.beneficial_wards == 0) any<ward> @ self | "Feint Mass - Amulet" | any<trap & !aoe & stacks>[potent] @ boss | ?(self.beneficial_auras == 0) any<aura & out_damage> | any<damage & aoe>[any<mod_damage>] | any<damage>[any<mod_damage>] @ boss | any<global> | any<shadow> | any<trap & !aoe>[potent] @ boss | pass
description: Hitter for a boss that cheats when a blade is cast; it never casts or enchants one. Otherwise it plays as Default.
